notes: Hand-curated PK + vitals-effects rows forming the teaching formulary. 264 rows: 204 medications, 16 IV fluids / blood products, 13 oxygen / airway, 31 nursing. Every medication carries an RxNorm ingredient RxCUI (looked up live from RxNav) plus pk_source + pk_evidence_url; fluids, oxygen and nursing carry rxcui null and pk_source Curated (rohy). Drugs with no acute haemodynamic effect (antibiotics, statins, PPIs, ...) have all-zero effects with onset/peak/duration reflecting dosing so they remain orderable and scorable. Rows are grouped by treatment_type; the rohy-2026-08 additions are alphabetical within each block. Do not rename rows: case_treatments overlays reference treatment_name.
